name: variant.exclude
title: Exclude requirements from variant
summary: Exclude core requirements for a variant; written into the variant file only.
whileReadOnlyReason: Writes a variant file, and no change can be checked against a missing or faulty metamodel.

variant.description: The variant. An element whose type has no meaning `variant` is `input.invalid` with `details.reason: "not-a-variant"`; an unknown or ambiguous reference is `ref.unknown` or `ref.ambiguous`.

refs.description: The core requirements to exclude, or with `undo` whose exclusion to remove. Adding an exclusion of a requirement with a validity, a need or a package is refused (SR-042 AK4): `input.invalid` with `details.reason: "not-core"` and `details.refs` (the refused refs); nothing is written. With `undo` every exclusion entry that is there is removed, also one of no core requirement (SR-042 AK7).

undo.description: Remove the exclusions of `refs` instead. An exclusion that is not there is an `info` problem `relation.not-found` in `problems`, as relation.remove gives it; the other refs are undone.

items.description: Written file, relative to the workspace root.
